title: Noita Glyph Font
description: This resource pack replaces Minecraft's default font with the glyph from the game Noita
body:
**Noita Font for Minecraft**

This resource pack replaces Minecraft's default font with the font from the game **Noita**, created by **Skyar_**. Now all in-game text — from the interface to chat — looks exactly like it does in **Noita**.

The font works with almost all languages that use Latin characters, but it does **not** support Cyrillic or Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters.
